name: transcripts
description: Every talking-head take's lines in one call, with the ids cut's plan uses (A1, D7...): each line's seconds in its source and its words, retakes and asides included. scope "timeline": what plays on the timeline now, in timeline seconds. words: each word with its start and end. Read-only; complete, never trimmed.

input.description: The project id, its folder, or the absolute path of its project.json

output.description: {scope, text} by default; words: {scope, lines: {id: [[text, start, end]]}}, or for the timeline {scope, items: [{item, track, start, end, src, lines, words}]}

params.name: project
params.description: The project id, its folder, or the absolute path of its project.json

params.name: scope
params.description: "all", "timeline", or source ids or letters, comma-separated ("clip-3", "D").

params.name: words
params.description: Each word with its start and end, not lines of text.
